_comment: Pocket Clawd settings. Delete any line you don't need -- every key has a
sensible default. Copy this to config.json (the installer does that for
you) and edit it on the console or from your PC over the network.
mode: how usage data reaches this console.
push   - a PC sends it to us. The default, and needs no setup here.
pull   - we fetch it from a PC that is running the pusher with --serve.
direct - we ask Anthropic ourselves, using token.json next to this file.
Works with no PC at all, including away from home. Read
docs/NETWORKING.md first: it puts a token on the SD card.
buttons: only needed if this handheld reports unusual codes. Rather than
guess, run 'python3 clawd.py --map-buttons' on the console and press
each button when asked -- it writes the right numbers in here.
